items.independentDerivation: At t = 2 and 4, respectively, B exp(2k) = 1750 and B exp(4k) = 2450. Their ratio gives exp(2k) = 1.4, so k = ln(1.4)/2 approximately 0.168236 and B = 1750/1.4 = 1250. For 2200 degrees, exp(kt) = 2150/1250 = 1.72, hence t = ln(1.72)/k approximately 3.223590 hours = 3 hours 13.415 minutes. B (3 h 13 min) is nearest; A is 3 h 42 min, C 2 h 42 min and D 2 h 13 min.
